claims.excerpt: De aanvragerservaring werd eerst naar alpha gebracht; plannen voor caseworkers kwamen later.
claims.claim: The team took the applicant experience to alpha first, and plans for caseworker users came later.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: My team focused on the users applying for refunds first and this is what we took to the alpha assessment. Plans for the caseworker user came later.
claims.narrative: eerst de aanvragerservaring uitwerken, later caseworkerwerk toevoegen

claims.excerpt: Tijdens de private beta wisselden tweewekelijkse sprints af: in de ene periode werden aanvragen aangenomen, in de andere was tijd gereserveerd voor testen, onderzoek en verwerking.
claims.claim: During private beta, separate fortnightly sprints alternated between accepting applications and reserving time for testing, research, and processing.
claims.label: F2 material incorrect, unsupported or misleading
claims.evidence: We achieved this by splitting our fortnightly sprints in two: testing, researching and accepting applications in the first week and then suspending submissions to concentrate on testing, researching and processing applications the second.
claims.narrative: Tijdens de private beta wisselden tweewekelijkse sprints af tussen aanvragen aannemen en tijd besteden aan testen, onderzoek en verwerking.
claims.explanation: The source says each fortnightly sprint was split into two weeks, not that fortnightly sprints alternated between those modes. The first week included testing and research as well as accepting applications; submissions were suspended in the second week. The piece changes both the cadence and the relationship between activities. The narrative repeats this framing.
claims.materiality: Material: it misstates the team’s work rhythm and which activities occurred together.

claims.excerpt: Zo beschreef de aanpak een volgorde waarin aanvragers eerst kwamen, naast vaste tijd voor onderzoek en testen.
claims.claim: The described approach prioritized applicants first while setting aside regular time for research and testing.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: My team focused on the users applying for refunds first and this is what we took to the alpha assessment. Plans for the caseworker user came later. ... We achieved this by splitting our fortnightly sprints in two: testing, researching and accepting applications in the first week and then suspending submissions to concentrate on testing, researching and processing applications the second.
claims.narrative: De beschreven aanpak combineerde een volgorde waarin aanvragers eerst kwamen met expliciet gereserveerde tijd voor onderzoek en testen.
claims.explanation: The source supports both the applicant-first sequence and dedicated time for research and testing. This summary does not claim that either practice caused the launch or results.
claims.materiality: Material to the piece’s central account of the approach; accurately represented.
